title: Credited-Share Rule for Reversing Pre-K Tuition Late Fees
content:
**Rule.** Under the credited-share rule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the part of a Pre-K tuition late fee that is reversed follows the share of the month's tuition that eligibility credits have taken off. The month is the enrollment's most recent billing month; the credits counted are those with the credit reason "eligibility established" standing against that month's tuition charge.

| Eligibility credits standing against the month's tuition charge | Reversed under this rule |
|---|---|
| equal to or more than the charge | the whole late fee |
| more than zero but less than the charge | the late fee pro rata: multiplied by those credits and divided by the charge |
| none | nothing |

## Worked reversals (hypothetical month: tuition charge 450.00, late fee 36.00)

| Eligibility credits on the charge | Share | Reversed |
|---|---|---|
| 450.00 | the whole charge | 36.00 |
| 300.00 | 300.00 of 450.00 | 36.00 multiplied by 300.00, divided by 450.00: 24.00 |
| 112.50 | 112.50 of 450.00 | 9.00 |
| none | none | nothing |
